Name: StarAmy's Museum Furniture 1.6 for FF
Author: Ashrayne
Description:
[i][size=4][b]Presenting: StarAmy's [/b][/size][/i][size=4][i][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19035/]Museum Furniture[/url], ported to Furniture Framework for SDV 1.6.[/b]

[/i][/size][i][size=4][b]Features[/b]:[/size]
[list]
[*]21 museum-inspired signs & display cases, available with or without glass covering cases or glass cabinet doors
[*]The Marble Pedestal can be placed either indoors or outdoors, great for decorating!
[*]Access this mod's furniture set from StarAmy's furniture catalogue if you have that installed (see optional mod requirements)
[/list]
[size=3][b]Why this mod exists[/b]:[/size]
Furniture Display Framework originally by Aedenthorn did not survive the transition to 1.6 terribly well. Among other things, it currently suffers from a complete inability to display any modded object sprite correctly. If you're anything like me and love decorating, being restricted to only displaying vanilla objects around your farm is a total non-starter. Thankfully, we now have an alternative: [/i][i][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458/]Furniture Framework[/url] by Leroymilo!

Huge shout-out to Leroymilo for making FF and answering my many questions on Discord!

[/i][size=3][b][i]Recommended Pairings[/i][/b][/size]:
[list]
[*]Trek deep into the mountains to expand your gem collection with Lumisteria's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9600/]Visit Mount Vapius[/url]
[*]Turn tree sap into elegant creations with Miru's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16127/]Forest Amber[/url] (pictured in screenshot)
[/list]
[size=3][i][b]Installation Instructions[/b][/i][/size]:
[list]
[*]Install any and all StarAmy [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19035/]Museum Valley 1.6[/url] modules of your choice EXCEPT for her Museum Furniture using FDF set (and endorse her mod ofc)
[*]Install this mod and all dependencies
[*]Enjoy decorating with ALLLLL the cute modded objects!
[/list]
StarAmy's most determined superfan is BAAAACCKK! I, um, mostly have permission for this? I asked StarAmy if I could port another of her mods to FF and then got epically distracted when she dropped NEW CUTE FURNITURE on us, and I absolutely had to have her Trophy Case to display my amber collection like yesterday? For the record, this was hilariously among the most difficult possible choices I could have used to learn how to code a furniture pack, but I made it! Ta-da! *drops a fully-operational furniture pack on the community and runs away*

Downloads.Description: For FF version 3.0+ ONLY. StarAmy's furniture catalogue is now REQUIRED.
